subject: P007 J2 seal-contact surface texture for K01-D-006 engineering review
problem: K01-D-006 requires a controlled surface-texture requirement on the P007 face contacted by the static J2 O-ring. The exact seal compound/media/leak qualification remains open.
requirements: Do not invent a global surface finish for non-functional surfaces

accepted_option.surface: P007 J2 mating/seal-contact face (Datum-A functional plane)
accepted_option.release_condition: Confirm against final seal product/compound, media/cleaning envelope and leak-test qualification before RELEASE_PASS.

technical_filter.function: Static elastomer face seal against P007 mating face
technical_filter.manufacturing: 0.8 µm Ra is practical on a machined/finished 316L sealing face
technical_filter.inspection: Profilometer / surface-texture instrument on accessible P007 sealing face
technical_filter.reliability: Gas/vacuum sealing is sensitive to fine surface leakage paths
technical_filter.cost: Chosen as a reasonable engineering-review limit without forcing 0.4 µm unless final leak qualification requires it

evidence: Parker O-Ring Handbook ORD 5700: gas/vacuum O-ring sealing surfaces require smoother-than-normal finish; 16 RMS is common and 32 RMS has been used successfully.
32 microinch Ra is approximately 0.8 micrometre Ra.

rejected_options.option: Global Ra requirement on all P007 surfaces
rejected_options.why: Not functionally justified and increases manufacturing cost.
Potentially beneficial for vacuum but not yet justified by the still-open seal/media/leak requirement.
Leaves a real sealing-interface design input undefined.

impact: Adds a native surface-finish symbol to the engineering-review K01-D-006 on the J2 seal-contact face.
PDG-SURFACE-TEXTURE remains release-conditional until seal/media/leak closure.

tz_preflight.product_evidence_automation: This decision and the V2 drawing automation directly reduce work on the current deliverable.
